findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 10 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: Identity (vii) is printed as \cos(\alpha + \beta) - \cos(\alpha - \beta) = 2\cos\alpha\cos\beta. Adding (iii) and (iv) gives a plus sign: \cos(\alpha + \beta) + \cos(\alpha - \beta) = 2\cos\alpha\cos\beta (the \sin\alpha\sin\beta terms cancel). The book's own box below uses the correct +.

Book correction: In Example 17 the book prints the second pair as 2\cos\frac{7\theta + \theta}{2}\cos\frac{7\theta - 5\theta}{2}. The pair is \cos 7\theta + \cos 5\theta, so it must be 2\cos\frac{7\theta + 5\theta}{2}\cos\frac{7\theta - 5\theta}{2} = 2\cos 6\theta\cos\theta. The book's next line (2\cos 6\theta\cos\theta) is correct.
